note: [M]'s inequality is the case P = id of Lean's statements, and Lean allows any bounded self-adjoint or inner-product-preserving P fixing U H and open regions Q, W. The unballed MaxwellCountertests drops the ball about zero, so the ball version comes from regions_excludes and InvariantCountertests.

snippet.text:
lemma regions_excludes (hr:0<r) (ha:0<A)(ht: EuclideanAsymptotic F A)(X:Comparison F U) : ¬ Regions r F U := by
    intro hi; obtain ⟨μ,hμ,-⟩:= traceSpectrum_exists F
    exact saturate X (hi.localball hr) hμ ha ht

proof_context.conclusion: For r>0, `EuclideanAsymptotic F A` with `0<A` and a `Comparison`, no bounded self-adjoint P fixing `U H` satisfies the equality on all tests with f in open Q (closure in `ball 0 r`) and real h in open W spacelike to Q; P = id gives the ball version of the inequality.

snippet.text:
def InvariantCountertests (F : Final C q S) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient n), Comparison F U →
    ∀ (I : Type v) [MeasurableSpace I] (μ : Measure I) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
    ∀ (P : I → Ambient n → Ambient n),
      (∀ z x y, PhysicalWave x → PhysicalWave y →
        inner ℂ (P z x) (P z y) = inner ℂ x y) →
      (∀ z x, P z (U x) = U x) →
    ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r →
      ∃ (Q W : Set E4), IsOpen Q ∧ IsOpen W ∧ closure Q ⊆ ball 0 r ∧
        (∀ x ∈ closure Q, ∀ y ∈ closure W, x-y ∈ spacelike) ∧
        ∃ (f : Test4) (h : TestList n), tsupport f ⊆ Q ∧ HasCompactSupport ⇑f ∧
          (∀ i, tsupport (h i) ⊆ W) ∧ (∀ i, HasCompactSupport ⇑(h i)) ∧
          (∀ i, Probe.bar (h i) = h i) ∧
          (∫ z, inner ℂ (P z (coherent (-h))) (signal F U f) ∂μ) ≠
            ∫ z, inner ℂ (signal F U (Probe.bar f)) (P z (coherent h)) ∂μ

proof_context.conclusion: Manuscript-shaped existence form with `P z`: there are open Q, W and tests with the two averages different.

snippet.text:
def MaxwellCountertests (F : Final C q S) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : F.action.operators.H →ₗᵢ[ℂ] Ambient n), Comparison F U →
    ∃ (f : Test4) (h : TestList n), HasCompactSupport ⇑f ∧
      (∀ i, HasCompactSupport ⇑(h i)) ∧ (∀ i, Probe.bar (h i) = h i) ∧
      (∀ i, Fields.causal f (h i)) ∧
      inner ℂ (coherent (-h)) (signal F U f) ≠
        inner ℂ (signal F U (Probe.bar f)) (coherent h)

proof_context.conclusion: For every n and Comparison there are f, h compactly supported, h real and causally separated from f, with `<coherent(-h), signal f> ≠ <signal f̄, coherent h>`.
